node: Government-funded engineering, construction, and grid execution
summary: Expanded direct public-company universe for the government-funded construction execution node. The strongest reference anchor is Quanta Services because it is the obvious scaled electric-infrastructure execution platform. The underfollowed lane is better represented by MYR Group and Primoris, which are smaller specialty contractors with direct transmission, distribution, utility, and power-delivery exposure. MasTec is included as a large-cap bridge candidate because its power-delivery, clean-energy, communications, and infrastructure backlog can capture policy-driven utility and industrial spending, though its size and investor attention make it less underfollowed than MYRG or PRIM. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
